articles.title: Study of 500 Ice Age spear points reveals how Clovis hunters managed risk
articles.summary: A fascinating study delved into the projectile points utilized by ancient Clovis and Cumberland cultures in Tennessee, analyzing nearly 500 artifacts from the late Ice Age. This suggests an evolving approach to resource management, emphasizing the growing familiarity with their environment over generations.

articles.title: Scientists test 16 Asian elephants with hidden fruit; they learn to follow box

Studies indicate that these elephants can switch from direct feeding techniques to indirect methods as needed. While older elephants may find such adaptations more difficult due to slower reflexes, the ability to change tactics is crucial for their social dynamics. This insight into their behavioral flexibility could significantly improve strategies for harmonious coexistence with humans.

articles.summary: Virat Kohli reached 15,002 runs from 315 matches and 303 innings. He has scored 54 centuries and 80 fifties in ODIs, with a highest score of 183. His ODI batting average stands at 58.83, while his strike rate is more than 94.

articles.title: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt
articles.summary: Beginning in September 2026, the USCIS unveiled new regulations affecting Green Card seekers. These guidelines emphasize the financial self-sufficiency of applicants while excluding those in humanitarian categories. Nearly all applicants, including family and various occupational groups, must satisfy these criteria. While the Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is crucial, it cannot guarantee approval on its own.

articles.title: Barrier-free tolling: How FASTag & number plates will auto-collect toll
articles.summary: With barrier-free tolling, vehicles can move through at normal highway speeds while cameras and FASTag systems identify the vehicle and collect the toll automatically.

articles.title: $17.1M to restore 206,000 acres, 225 miles for wildlife movement in West
articles.summary: The National Fish and Wildlife Foundation has announced $13.3 million in grants for 14 projects across the western US. With $3.8 million in matching contributions, the conservation work will have a total impact of $17.1 million. The projects will restore habitat, improve migration corridors and modify 225 miles of fencing for wildlife.

articles.title: When ‘secret spot’ goes viral: The tourism trap of too many views, too many visitors
Parvesh Verma slap row: Man files complaint, police reveal prior FIR against him
articles.summary: Delhi Police has received a complaint regarding an alleged incident involving Minister Parvesh Verma. The complaint states that Verma slapped a man during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar. AAP leader Jarnail Singh was present and questioned the quality of the road when the incident occurred. Verma disputes the allegations, claiming the video does not show the full context.

articles.title: Are Justin and Patrick Herbert brothers? The Oregon and Chargers connection explained
articles.summary: In a thrilling matchup against the Buffalo Bills, Patrick Herbert prepares for his NFL debut, teaming up with his brother Justin Herbert. The duo, who played together at Oregon, never connected on any passes during their college years. After going undrafted in 2025, Patrick joined the Chargers' practice squad, and following tight end injuries, he's been promoted to the active roster.

articles.title: 1980 garage business for son's job now helped 12,500 people
articles.summary: Charles P. Baker III, who died at 101, co-founded Baker Industries with his wife Louise in 1980 after their son struggled to find suitable work. What began as a two-person garage business grew into a workforce development nonprofit that has hired, trained and mentored more than 12,500 people who faced barriers to employment.

articles.title: Yellowstone rangers pulled 20,100 items from geysers, including 280 hats
articles.summary: Yellowstone rangers removed more than 20,100 pieces of trash from geothermal areas in 2026, along with over 5,000 rocks and sticks and 280 visitor hats. Staff also collected coins worth more than $18. Among the unusual finds were AirPods, golf tees, an inhaler, Invisalign retainers, fake nails and children’s toys.

articles.title: Rob Lowe says he was happy after Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at Oscars
articles.summary: Rob Lowe has revealed he was “the only person happy” when Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at the 2022 Oscars, hoping the shocking incident would overshadow his infamous 1989 Academy Awards performance. Lowe joked that his decades-old Oscars blunder continues to haunt him, despite Smith’s slap becoming one of Hollywood’s biggest controversies.

articles.title: ‘Illegal detention by Assam Police has finally ended’: CJP’s Ranka to address press
articles.summary: Ashutosh Ranka, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janta Party, reported his detention by Assam Police has ended. He stated that he will address the media after being taken back to the original pick-up location. Several other CJP leaders were also detained in Guwahati before a regional volunteers' meeting near the Assam Secretariat. Police prevented access to the meeting site, which aimed to gather around 200-300 volunteers from the region.

articles.title: 'Won't bow our head': Iran embassy invokes Baahubali to echo Pezeshkian's UN speech
articles.summary: Highlighting the parallels between resilience and heroism, the Iranian Embassy in Hyderabad unveiled a video featuring President Masoud Pezeshkian's UNGA address likened to the epic tale of Baahubali. The embassy conveyed Iran's steadfastness against external pressures, as exemplified in Dr. Pezeshkian's rejection of U.S. sanctions. He asserted Iran's commitment to dialogue while maintaining a robust defense posture, amidst escalating U.S.-Iran tensions.

articles.title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s investment reaches 5,000 stores in $2.9 billion move
articles.summary: Jason Kelce has made a savvy equity investment in Hank Sauce via Winnie Capital, marking a significant step for both him and the brand. Once a local staple, Hank Sauce now boasts distribution in over 5,000 stores across the country. With a U.S. hot sauce market worth nearly $2.9 billion, this partnership looks to amplify Hank Sauce's visibility and reach nationally, taking advantage of the substantial growth opportunities ahead.

articles.title: Shohei Ohtani’s $700 million Dodgers contract and what it means for MLB
articles.summary: Shohei Ohtani’s $700 million contract with the Los Angeles Dodgers sounds like a blockbuster headline figure, but the deal is far more unusual than that. The deal shifted the Dodgers' payroll strategy with $680 million deferred until 2034-43, and Ohtani's commercial appeal drew major attention in Japan and around the world. The deal also helped to change how massive player contracts can be structured by MLB teams.

articles.title: 'I promised myself': Virat Kohli after 15,000-run landmark
articles.summary: Virat Kohli became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to complete 15,000 ODI runs. He also hit his record-extending 55th ODI century as India beat West Indies by eight wickets in the first ODI. Kohli said his priority has always been to understand the situation and do what the team needs.

articles.title: Asian Games: Athletics leads India’s seven-medal haul, three boxers assure medals
articles.summary: India showcased a stellar performance at the Asian Games 2026, clinching a total of seven medals, predominantly in athletics and squash. Parul Chaudhary shone brightly, securing a bronze in the women’s 3000m steeplechase. Silver medals were added by Ancy Sojan and Sarvesh Kushare in their respective disciplines. The boxing team also excelled, confirming three medals through successful semifinal performances.

articles.title: Nepal battered by severe rain: 21 dead, 5 missing as floods, landslides worsen
articles.summary: In Nepal, heavy rainfall has caused devastating floods and landslides, resulting in 21 lives lost and extensive damage. Authorities have evacuated around 3,000 residents from perilous areas to guarantee their safety. This deluge follows the earlier Bhotekoshi floods, which had a death toll of over 1,400. As rescue efforts continue, landslides have disrupted operations in several districts, and tourists in vulnerable areas are being advised to take precautions.

articles.title: IndiGo A321 enroute Blr suffers tail strike; plane lands safely in second attempt
articles.summary: On Sunday, an IndiGo Airbus A321 operating flight 6E 6542 experienced a tail strike during a go-around. The incident occurred while attempting to land in gusty weather at Bengaluru airport. All passengers and crew were safely disembarked, and the aircraft is undergoing maintenance checks. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation is investigating the incident and has engaged with IndiGo regarding pilot training enhancements.

articles.title: US rejects Iran's claim of capturing underwater drone, calls move 'desperate'
articles.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has reported the capture of a US underwater drone in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. In response, the US military dismissed this assertion, clarifying that the drone in question had experienced a malfunction prior to any claims from Iran. This development follows Iran's earlier announcement regarding another US military drone capture.

articles.title: Panda-monium: When diplomacy goes to the dogs, horses, and elephants
articles.summary: Get ready, Atlanta! Two charming giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, will be gracing the zoo with their presence this Monday, thanks to a decade-long conservation agreement. This unique event reflects the tradition of panda diplomacy, which has played a pivotal role in fostering international friendships. The nuances of this approach reveal essential lessons in both diplomacy and environmental conservation.

articles.title: '40km chase': Cop clings to speeding car to catch smugglers in Coimbatore; watch
articles.summary: In Coimbatore district, Kovilpalayam police engaged in a thrilling 40km chase after suspected smugglers failed to heed police signals. Remarkably, a daring officer climbed onto the suspects' vehicle during the pursuit, making it a high-stakes operation. The pursuit came to an end when the police successfully intercepted the fleeing car, leading to the suspects' arrest. However, details about the smuggling operation are still scarce.

articles.title: Virat Kohli breaks Sachin Tendulkar's record for most ODI centuries against a team
articles.summary: The century was Virat Kohli's 55th in ODI cricket. It was also his 86th international hundred. His international centuries include 30 in Tests, 55 in ODIs and one in T20Is. Kohli has now scored 55 ODI hundreds, extending his lead among active players in the format.

The deployment follows repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi oil facilities and aims to secure the Red Sea port of Yanbu. French official Jean-Noel Barrot emphasized that France's role is strictly defensive and does not equate to participation in the conflict.

NCP (SP) spokesperson Anish Gawande condemned the detentions, labeling them illegal and unconstitutional. The CJP remains dedicated to advocating for social issues despite these setbacks.

articles.title: Asian Games: Why India dropped out of top 10 despite winning seven more medals
articles.summary: India added seven medals on Day 8 of the Asian Games, including two silver medals in squash and five in athletics. Parul Chaudhary achieved a new national record in the women's 3000m steeplechase, winning bronze. However, India did not win any gold medals, leading to a drop in its overall standings. Boxers Parveen Hooda, Ankush Panghal, and Narender secured medals by reaching the semifinals.

articles.title: 'American terrorist army': Iran claims second US submarine seized in Hormuz
IIT-B student suicide: What law says about abetment, instigation and ‘guilty mind’
articles.summary: The heartbreaking suicide of a second-year IIT-Bombay student has ignited debates over complex legal matters concerning abetment. Professor Suryanarayana Doolla finds himself charged with abetting the tragedy, drawing emotional protests from the victim's family. The rarity of successful prosecutions in such cases poses additional challenges, as the Supreme Court insists on clear evidence of intentional instigation.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu govt rolls back law and order department’s RTI exemption amid backlash
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government faced backlash after it issued a notification that exempted the Public (Law and Order) Department from the Right to Information (RTI) Act. Critics, including numerous political leaders, argued that such an action would jeopardize transparency and obstruct public access to crucial law records. In response to widespread criticism, the government promptly withdrew the exemption, reaffirming its commitment to uphold the RTI Act.

articles.title: Gold and silver outlook: Job data, crude and more in focus to guide bullion this week
articles.summary: The gold and silver markets are poised for significant fluctuations as crucial US jobs and inflation data are on the horizon. Investors are keenly aware of the Federal Reserve's hints about possible policy adjustments, which could greatly influence precious metals. Additionally, consumer confidence, GDP figures, and inflation metrics from the Eurozone are on the radar.

NEET leak fallout: CISF to guard NTA’s confidential exam areas
articles.summary: Responding to the alarming issue of exam paper leaks, the National Testing Agency has fortified its security protocols. A dedicated team of 29 CISF personnel is now assigned to the agency's new office for rigorous oversight. In addition to advancing cybersecurity measures, the NTA is revisiting its entire examination-cycle systems to thwart unauthorized access. Independent audits will also be conducted, aiming for a significant improvement in examination integrity moving forward.

articles.title: ‘Hurled abuses at my family’: Delhi minister reveals ‘truth’ behind viral slap video
articles.summary: During a recent road inspection in Tilak Nagar, Delhi's PWD Minister Parvesh Verma faced backlash after a video emerged of him allegedly slapping a local youth. Verma stated that he acted in response to an insult aimed at his family from the youth's associate. Additionally, he accused local MLA Jarnail Singh of trying to extract commissions from roadwork contracts. Following the incident, Verma's engineer has filed an FIR.

articles.title: 'Giving back to my country': Dubai teen uses birthday savings to build solar plant in UP
articles.summary: Vehaan Subramanian, an 18-year-old from Dubai, created a water treatment plant in Uttar Pradesh. The project, named ARUNA, treats arsenic-contaminated groundwater for local communities. Funding was primarily sourced from his personal savings and a reading club he managed. Residents were trained to operate and maintain the facility for sustainable access to clean water. This initiative exemplifies the collaborative efforts between local government and citizens addressing critical water quality issues.

articles.title: Who is Sarvesh Kushare? From Hangzhou heartbreak to Asian Games silver in Japan
articles.summary: Kushare cleared 2.25m to finish second. Chinese Taipei's Chao-hsuan Fu also cleared 2.25m but won gold, while South Korea's Sanghyeok Woo took bronze with a best effort of 2.22m. He cleared 2.10m, 2.14m, 2.18m, 2.22m and 2.25m before failing to clear 2.28m in all three attempts.

articles.title: Chess Olympiad: Savitha heroics bring medal; Arjun helps India bag Open silver

Savitha Shri’s resilient 83-move draw sealed bronze for the women, while Arjun Erigaisi’s dramatic late victory helped the open team win silver on tiebreak. Uzbekistan took open gold and China won women’s gold. India also claimed the Gaprindashvili Cup for the best combined performance.

With a remarkable total of 7,934 points, he secured a podium position, while Japan's Yuma Maruyama took the gold. Meanwhile, Ancy Sojan finished just shy of gold in the women's long jump, placing second behind China's Yingying Huang.

articles.title: New homes, new jobs: Why this Denver-area ZIP code is drawing movers

The ranking is based on a significant number of new housing developments in the area. Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, remains in second place due to military relocations that dominate its movement figures. Florida has three spots in the top ten, appealing to retirees and remote workers.

articles.title: 'Oye maar kaise raha hai': On cam, Delhi minister Parvesh Verma slaps man

articles.title: Kashmera backs Sunita Ahuja: Actor questions Komal Rani’s affair claims

articles.title: Asian Games: Ancy Sojan misses gold by 2cm, Shaili loses bronze on final jump

Shaili Singh, meanwhile, faced disappointment, slipping to fourth place with a last jump that pushed her down after Mengyi Tan's leap.
